text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The first three years of the Twinkle
Series are
behind us, and we've finally
found a day to relax
and take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, Trainer! Are you free this
weekend?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I can't help but worry she wants to invite
me to go
foraging for food in the
mountains or at the
beach again, and
brace myself for her next words.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay! It's finally time to fulfill the promise
we made
with each other, then!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's go on a hot spring getaway!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Then, on the day of our hot spring
vacation...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hellooo!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! The truth is, this inn has a
secret...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And that's that it has veeery buono
food!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
We might be here on vacation, but this
is
doubling as a training excursion!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to learn about yummy foods,
sharpen
my skills, and expand my
repertoire of buono
recipes while I'm
here! ☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'll take this challenge on like
sumo
wrestlers take on their foes!
Dosukoi! Dosukoi!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Akebono's got her plans, but since
there's
some time before dinner, we end
up checking out
the hot spring first.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh. That felt wonderful... The water
was so
nice...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I understand what it feels like
to be a
chicken meatball now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of which, it's almost
dinnertime!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Now, settle your weight,
ready your
stance... To battle!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, wooow!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They served us appetizers, sushi, local
specialties,
some stewed, steamed, and
pickled dishes, and
pilaf in a pot with
soup!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh... They all look so luscious and
yummy!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it'd be a waste to let the food get
cold, so
let's eat now!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! Every one of these dishes is
buono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
This fish is so buono even though it was
just
grilled with salt!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Every entree has been perfectly
prepared, but the
grilled dishes are
particularly delicious. Every bite
melts in
my mouth.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
They must have grilled everything over
charcoal and
used special salt. I think it
might be Camargue salt.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
What did they use to make this broth,
though? Shiitake
mushrooms... and dried
sardines, maybe? The veggies
are cut so
beautifully too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes glitter with excitement as she
murmurs
to herself while sipping and
comparing broths.
The night goes on in
much the same way...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm stuffed!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Inns are such great places... It's like they
serve
pure joy...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite the shocking amount of food
they gave
us, we manage to polish
everything off between
the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh! I love making it, eating it, and
learning
new recipes! I just love
everything about food,
especially
cooking!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And the more you learn about cooking,
the more
your knowledge of it builds.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The fun part is seeing how everything,
from
good-quality ingredients to the
strength of
different seasonings, comes
together to make
buono dishes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I guess you could say that the
fundamentals of
cooking are all worth
their weight in salt.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! ♪ I have a theory, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Everybody wants to make lots and lots
of tasty
and nutritious food for the
people who mean the
most to them.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I think it was through generations of
carefully
passing down the desire to
nourish loved ones
that gave birth to the
basics of cooking.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'll always treasure the things
my
parents taught me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
As well as everything I've learned here
today at
this inn.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you're a very important person
to me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
And I hope that you'll will always be
happy and
find life buono.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it amazing how happy food and
cooking can
make the most important
people in your life feel?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to master this grilling technique
when we
get back! ♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Especially since you liked the grilled
food so
much.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I guess it's because we've been
together
so long...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
But I can tell when you think something
is buono,
even if you don't show it on
your face! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I sense that Hishi Akebono and I have
formed an
irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
